description: This file defines API endpoints for encoding and decoding management frames using FastAPI. It includes data models for request and response payloads, and relies on imported management frame models and registry services.

classes.name: EncodeRequest
classes.description: Request model for encoding a management frame, specifying frame type, header, and payload in hex.

classes.name: EncodeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the encoded frame as a hex string.

classes.name: DecodeRequest
classes.description: Request model for decoding a frame, containing the frame in hex.

classes.name: DecodeResponse
classes.description: Decoded frame details including frame type, header, and payload in hex.

methods.name: EncodeResponse encode_frame(req: EncodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service))
methods.description: FASTAPI endpoint to encode a management frame into a hex string.

methods.name: DecodeResponse decode_frame(req: DecodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service))
methods.description: FASTAPI endpoint to decode a hex-encoded management frame into its components.

ctags.name: decode_frame
ctags.pattern: /^def decode_frame(req: DecodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service)) -> De/

ctags.name: encode_frame
ctags.pattern: /^def encode_frame(req: EncodeRequest, reg: MGMTRegistryService = Depends(get_mgmt_service)) -> En/

ctags.name: header
ctags.pattern: /^    header: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Arbitrary header map.")$/

ctags.name: payload_hex
ctags.pattern: /^    payload_hex: str = Field(default="", description="Hex-encoded payload bytes.")$/
